clauses.text: ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA AND OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS All the eligibility criteria (Qualification, Age, Experience etc.) for this post shall be computed as on 01.10.2023 (inclusive)
Short-listing for interview will be on the basis of the details provided by the candidates (regarding educational qualification and work experience) in the online application

All candidates will have to produce, if called for interview, originals as well as attested photocopies of documents in support of their eligibility such as age, educational qualification, experience or any other required certificate, failing which their candidature will be cancelled.
